svg.title: Dueline system context
svg.desc: The freelancer uses Dueline in a browser and gives the CA export files. A scheduler calls Dueline every morning at 06:00 India time. Dueline creates, sends and reminds invoices through PayPal Invoicing v2, reads fees and net amounts from PayPal Payments and Transaction Search, and receives signed PayPal webhooks. The client opens the invoice on PayPal's own checkout page and pays there. Dueline sends masked chats to Gemini, keeps its state in Postgres and reads European Central Bank rates through Frankfurter. The animation follows one invoice in ten steps from the freelancer's approval to the CSV file for the CA.
svg.text: Who uses Dueline and which outside systems it talks to. PayPal sandbox only.

g.text: The freelancer pastes a client chat and approves a draft
Dueline sends the chat to Gemini with contacts masked
Dueline creates and sends the invoice through PayPal Invoicing v2
The client opens the invoice and pays on PayPal's own page
PayPal sends a signed webhook and Dueline verifies it
Dueline reads PayPal's real fee and net amount
Dueline reads the ECB rate to show the rupees
Dueline stores the invoice snapshot and payout in Postgres
Every morning the scheduler starts the morning run
The freelancer sends the CSV files to the CA
